author: claude
summary: Task 004 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: relocates VariantsSection (rebuild/move/delete controls) into the new Variants tabpanel added by task 001's VoiceDetailTabs, and promotes VoiceSettingsPanel directly into the same tab (previously item 5 of 8 in the voice catalog card's overflow menu). Investigated and fixed R3: the pre-task-001 VoiceLabPage.tsx call site passed inert stub props to VariantsSection (buildingProfiles={}, onBuildNow=async()=>false, requestConfirm=()=>undefined), which was a confirmed live bug -- variant rebuild silently failed, the building/spinner state never showed, and delete-confirmation dialogs never fired for this page. Fixed by wiring VoiceLabPage.tsx to the same useVoiceManagement hook VoicesPage.tsx already uses (real fetch-backed handleBuildNow/handleUpdateSettings, buildingProfiles synced from the live jobs map) plus a local confirmConfig/ConfirmModal pair (same pattern as VoicesModals.tsx).

files.change: New composition wrapper: renders VariantsSection plus a promoted VoiceSettingsPanel (edits the voice group's default variant's settings, filtered to the active engine's declared synthesis_settings on save).

Wires VariantsTab as the Variants tabpanel's content. Adds real requestConfirm/confirmConfig state + a rendered ConfirmModal, and calls useVoiceManagement(onRefresh, profiles, requestConfirm, jobs) for real buildingProfiles/handleBuildNow/handleUpdateSettings instead of carrying forward the pre-task-001 stub props. Derives the default variant (getDefaultVoiceProfileName) for the promoted Voice Settings panel and threads its settings/isSaving/onSave state. `jobs` prop is now read directly (previously renamed `_jobs` and unused pre-task-004).

New test: exercises VoiceLabPage's real VariantsTab call site (fetch mocked, hook not mocked) and asserts an observable real effect for R3 -- clicking Rebuild fires POST /api/speaker-profiles/:name/build with the correct speaker_id/variant_name form fields, and the button transitions to a real 'Rebuilding...' state driven by buildingProfiles. R1 revert-check performed manually (git stash was unsafe mid-session due to a stale unrelated stash entry): temporarily reintroduced the exact pre-fix stub props at the VoiceLabPage.tsx call site, confirmed both new assertions failed for the right reason (no fetch call observed; button never left 'Rebuild'), then restored the real wiring and confirmed both pass.

Scoped the 'keeps the status strip visible after switching tabs' assertion to the header's .voice-detail-header__status-strip element instead of screen-wide getByText('Default'), since the Variants tab now renders real VariantEditor rows (which also show a 'Default' variant label) instead of a placeholder.
